note: NEW FILE. Covers the RUNTIME ORCHESTRATION half of `update(camPos)` (:146-162) -- deciding, each frame, whether the fleet should be shown or hidden and actually flipping `fleet.SetActive` -- which is distinct from PlaneHallLayout.cs's already-existing claim on the same line range: that file ported the PURE MATH predicates (Walled/FleetVisible) as data-only functions with no Transform/Camera dependency; this file is the 'few dozen lines once that pipeline exists' its own header predicted, the MonoBehaviour that actually calls them from a REAL hall Transform and a REAL Camera.main each frame. Why this matters at all in Unity (not just a JS habit carried over): three.js has no occlusion culling, so a hall inside the show-distance radius draws all ~35 parked machines THROUGH its own walls (src/planehall.js:62-67 measured 1,087 such meshes); Unity's own culling does not make a hangar's CONTENTS disappear through its walls either, so the same one-switch fleet toggle is still worth having. EnsureAxes reads the hall's own Transform.right/forward directly (already unit vectors in Unity regardless of scale, unlike THREE's raw matrix columns which the JS has to re-normalise by hand) rather than re-deriving sin/cos of a stored yaw, and needs no further scale correction because ShedFill bakes its SCALE struct into the generated geometry, not into Transform.localScale (see ShedFill.cs's header). ComputeVisible is split out from Update() specifically so a probe can drive it with a known camera position with no running play loop. NOT PORTED, explicitly, with exact reasons: the cockpit-kit draw-distance toggle (:196-219 CockpitVisible math already exists in PlaneHallLayout, but PlaneHallFill.Fill() does not yet attach a PlaneCockpitBaker-built kit to any of the 35 hall-parked planes -- there is no live kit reference to toggle yet); and the Combat target-visibility coupling (:290 citymap.targets?.register plus the 'marks must hide when the fleet does' lesson) -- FleetVisible is exposed as a public bool specifically so a Combat-owned script can read it without this file reaching into Combat; EXACT WIRING NEEDED, for whoever holds the editor: wherever Combat's target registry exposes a per-target visibility flag, set it to this hall's `PlaneHallVisibility.FleetVisible` for every target registered from `ParkedPlanes`.
